title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Payment Crediting, Payment Channels and the Phone Payment Fee
content:
Ridgeline Customer Care applies the following rules to payments on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account.

**Credit date.** A payment received by the tier's payment cutoff Eastern Time on a business day is credited that day; a payment received after the cutoff, or on a Saturday, Sunday or federal holiday, is credited on the next business day. The credit date is the date the payment line carries.

**Channels.** A one-time payment may be made online, by mail, at any store register, or through a phone representative. Autopay drafts post on the due date.

**Debit authorization.** The cardholder must authorize the debit from the named bank account before a phone payment is posted. This authorization is the cardholder's own statement, given for the account the payment is made to.

**Payable statuses.** Payments are accepted on accounts whose status is active, suspended, closed or charged off — that is, as the account record shows it, never on an account still applied for or declined.

**Amount ceiling.** A one-time payment may not exceed the account's current balance.

**Phone payment fee.** A payment taken through a phone representative incurs the tier's phone representative payment fee, posted as a fee line of type phone payment fee that references the payment line. Online, autopay, mail and in-store payments never incur it, and no phone payment fee line is posted on a tier whose fee is 0.00.

## Credit dates (hypothetical, with a 17:00 cutoff and no federal holiday in the week)

| Payment received | Credited on |
|---|---|
| Tuesday 16:30 Eastern | Tuesday |
| Tuesday 17:30 Eastern | Wednesday |
| Saturday 10:00 Eastern | Monday |
| Friday 18:00 Eastern | Monday |

## Phone fee by channel (hypothetical tier fee of 9.95)

| Channel | Phone payment fee line |
|---|---|
| Phone representative | 9.95, referencing the payment |
| Online, autopay, mail, store register | none |

On a tier whose phone payment fee is 0.00 no fee line is posted for a phone payment either.
